name: literacy-arithmetic-school
reviewNotes: All 39 original glyph records reviewed, including score reactions, duplicate rank notices and the question-number field.
Preserve the intentionally wrong 13 + 2 = 582 joke, 10 ryo bribe and two leading spaces before the question label.
This block contains invitations, feedback and a question-number label, not the actual literacy or arithmetic question bank; no exam rules are changed.

來考考看嘛！一定，
能拿到高分吧！」

發明漢字的啊！
